item.title: 2. Planning
item.description:
1. Overview

ISO/IEC 42001 §6 requires a systematic way to identify and address risks and opportunities related to AI systems. In particular, §6.1.2 (AI risk assessment) and §6.1.4 (AI system impact assessment) are used directly to include risks that can arise from open source components.

2. §6.1.2 AI Risk Assessment: Including Open Source Risks ★

ISO/IEC 42001 requires a process to identify, analyze, and evaluate risks related to AI systems. Open source practitioners must explicitly include open source license risks and security vulnerability risks in this process.
